lines.en: I call Kaori to find out that she's currently wandering around her neighborhood looking for a place to purchase a cantaloupe.
lines.zh: 我打电话给 Kaori，才知道她正在附近街区转悠，想找个地方买哈密瓜。

lines.en: I decide against asking her {i}why{/i} she so desperately needs this large melon in the middle of the day and, instead, elect to just go help her find it.
lines.zh: 我决定不去问她{i}为什么{/i}大白天非要这么迫切地买这个大瓜，而是干脆过去帮她找。

lines.en: By the time I'm able to meet up with her, she's already forgotten what it was she was looking for, and the two of us just hang out and talk for a while instead.
lines.zh: 等我找到她时，她已经忘了自己要找什么了，于是我俩人就这么待着聊了一会儿。

lines.en: And I use the word 'talk' loosely because I'm not even sure how to recap the conversation from a narrator's perspective.
lines.zh: 「聊」这个词我用得很宽松，因为我根本不知道该怎么以旁观者的角度复述那段对话。

lines.en: Some time goes by before Kaori tells me she needs to go home and get ready for her shift at the bar.
lines.zh: 过了一阵，Kaori 说她得回家准备去酒吧上班了。

lines.en: It is just then that I realize Kaori {i}lives{/i} somewhere and doesn't just aimlessly wander from place to place in search of cats and melons.
lines.zh: 就在那时我才意识到，Kaori 是有{i}住处{/i}的，并不是为了找猫和瓜就无目的地四处游荡。

lines.en: I wonder what her house is like?...
lines.zh: 不知道她家是什么样子……

lines.en: Kaori drags me back to reality moments later and gives me a surprisingly enthusiastic fist-bump, which is apparently a thing she saw friends do on TV recently.
lines.zh: 几秒后 Kaori 把我拽回现实，出人意料地热情地跟我碰了个拳——据说这是她最近在电视上看到朋友之间会做的事。

lines.en: She quickly turns around and heads home and I am left confused and unsure of how to move on with my day...
lines.zh: 她很快转身回家去了，留下我一个人困惑地站在那儿，不知道这一天该怎么继续……
